objects.name: CodeQualityParameters
objects.description: Choose which severity levels of code quality results should block pull request merges. When configured, a code quality analysis must be done on the pull request before the changes can be merged.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: The lowest severity level at which code quality reviews need to be resolved before commits can be merged.
